newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan First Comm Bank cuts prime rate.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan First Comm Bank cuts prime rate.

text.p: First Commercial Bank, one of Taiwan's big three state-run banks, said on Tuesday it was cutting its prime lending rate by 0.05 percentage points to 7.55 percent from 7.60, effective on Tuesday.
"To cope with the currrent loose liquidity, we decided to cut our prime lending rate by 0.05 percentage points to 7.55 percent, effective from Tuesday," a company spokesman said by telephone.
First Commercial Bank was also cutting its three-month-to-three-year time deposit rates by between 0.05 and 0.15 percentage points, the spokesman said.
First Commercial is the first major bank to cut rates in recent weeks, with three other smaller banks also cutting rates from Tuesday to cope with the liquidity in the money market.
